scene thevaliumscene1
: How are you feeling?
lines.zh: : 你感觉怎么样？

lines.en: : You ever just think about phones?
lines.zh: : 你有没有就只是……想着手机？

lines.en: : Well, I guess that answers that question.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我想这个问题算是解决了。

lines.en: : No, seriously. I can just, like...press this glass in the right spots and then suddenly know more about bees.
lines.zh: : 不，说真的。我只要，那个……按对这块玻璃的地方，然后就突然知道了更多关于蜜蜂的事。

lines.en: : Who comes up with this stuff?
lines.zh: : 谁想出这些东西的？

lines.en: : I can’t tell if you’re so overtired that you’re acting high or if you’re just...you know, literally high.
lines.zh: : 我分不清你是累过头了表现得像嗨了一样，还是你……你知道的，真的嗨了。

lines.en: scene thevaliumscene2
: I wanna take a nap.
lines.zh: : 我想睡个午觉。

lines.en: : I can barely even remember what happened during the costume thing.
lines.zh: : 我几乎都记不清变装那会儿发生了什么。

lines.en: scene thevaliumscene3
: Yeah. Well, Io did say that short term memory loss can be a side effect. But hey, at least you’re not puking your brains out all over the carpet.
lines.zh: : 是啊。不过 Io 确实说过短暂失忆可能是副作用。但嘿，至少你没有吐得满地毯都是。

lines.en: : Where’d Sensei go? I wanna talk to him again now that I don’t have to keep sayin’ all those weird buzzwords anymore.
lines.zh: : 老师去哪儿了？我现在不用一直说那些怪流行语了，想再跟他聊聊。

lines.en: : He followed a dolphin outside last I saw.
lines.zh: : 我最后一次看到，他是跟着一只海豚出去了。

lines.en: : A dolphin? Maybe I really am high.
lines.zh: : 一只海豚？也许我真的嗨了。

lines.en: : I’m sure he’ll be back soon. It’s not like him to stay away from an entire room full of girls trying to get into his pants.
lines.zh: : 我相信他很快就会回来。整整一屋子想扒他裤子的女生，他不是那种会躲开的人。

lines.en: : I ain’t been followin’ the tally, but I hope my team wins...I miss the good old days when there were only ten of us fightin’ over Sensei’s pants.
lines.zh: : 我没在跟着计分，但我希望我这一队赢……我怀念以前只有我们十个人抢老师裤子的好日子。

lines.en: scene thevaliumscene4
: Are you officially a part of that fight now?
lines.zh: : 你现在正式加入那场争夺了吗？

lines.en: : Dunno what you’re talkin’ about.
lines.zh: : 不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : I’m asking if you have feelings for him or not. Like, real feelings. Not just pubescent curiosities.
lines.zh: : 我是问你有没有对他有感觉。就是，真的感觉。不只是青春期的好奇。

lines.en: : Pubescial what now?
lines.zh: : 青春什么？

lines.en: : When you see him...how does it make your heart feel? Is it like when you’re playing soccer? Watching a horror movie? Or is it more like...I don’t know. When you’re watching porn or something?
lines.zh: : 当你看到他的时候……你的心是什么感觉？像你踢足球的时候？看恐怖片的时候？还是更像……我不知道。你看色情片的时候之类的？

lines.en: : Maki says I can’t watch that stuff.
lines.zh: : Maki 说那种东西我不能看。

lines.en: : But if I had to compare it to somethin’...
lines.zh: : 但如果非要我拿什么来比的话……

lines.en: scene thevaliumscene5
: I’d say it’s closest to wakin’ up from a really nice dream.
lines.zh: : 我会说最接近的是从一个特别美好的梦里醒来。

lines.en: : Ain’t so much racin’ as it is feelin’ comfortable.
lines.zh: : 不是心跳加速，而是舒服。

lines.en: : All's I know is that I ain’t ever felt this way ‘bout anyone before. And that I get now why Makoto’s liked him for so long.
lines.zh: : 我只知道，我从来没有对任何人有过这种感觉。而且我现在懂了，为什么 Makoto 会喜欢他那么久。

lines.en: : Do you think I’ll ever feel that way about someone?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我也会有对谁产生那种感觉的一天吗？

lines.en: : That sounds nice...comfort, I mean. Being able to just be with somebody without being tempted to {i}do things{/i} with that person.
lines.zh: : 听起来不错……我是说，舒不舒服。能只是和某个人待在一起，而不被诱惑着去和那个人{i}做点什么{/i}。

lines.en: : I don’t know. Maybe I really am just a thirsty bitch at the end of the day. But I can’t help but feel a little jealous when other people know what they want.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。也许说到头来，我真的只是个饥渴的婊子。但当别人知道自己想要什么的时候，我还是忍不住有点嫉妒。

lines.en: scene thevaliumscene6
: Hey. Wake up.
lines.zh: : 嘿。醒醒。

lines.en: : Huh? Were you sayin’ somethin’ just now?
lines.zh: : 哈？你刚才在说什么吗？

lines.en: if kirin_lust >= 30 and miku_lust >= 10 and mikucostumewin == True:
scene thevaliumscene7
: When Sensei {i}does{/i} come back...
lines.zh: : 等老师{i}回来{/i}的时候……

lines.en: : Maybe we should see if he wants to hang out with just {i}us{/i} instead of the rest of the girls?
lines.zh: : 也许我们该问问他，想不想就{i}和我们俩{/i}一起玩，而不是跟其他女生一起？

lines.en: : That way...you’d get what you want in finally getting to spend time with him...
lines.zh: : 那样的话……你就能得到你想要的，终于能和他待一会儿……

lines.en: : And I could...
lines.zh: : 而我可以……

lines.en: : I could keep an eye on you...and make sure you don’t pass out or anything.
lines.zh: : 我可以看着你……确保你不会昏过去什么的。

lines.en: : I think that sounds nice. But Sensei’s not gonna wanna be with me when we’ve got people like Futaba walkin’ around with her bodonhonkaroos takin’ up half the room.
lines.zh: : 我觉得听起来不错。但老师不会想跟我在一起的，毕竟还有 Futaba 那种人，晃着她那对大宝贝占了半个房间。

lines.en: scene thevaliumscene8
: He chose you over Uta, you know. And Uta’s got some pretty nice bodonhonkaroos for a girl of her size.
lines.zh: : 他选了你，而不是 Uta，你知道吗。而以 Uta 那种身材，她那对大宝贝还挺不错的。

lines.en: : Don’t remind me.
lines.zh: : 别提醒我。

lines.en: : All I’m saying is...if this is the last night you get to be {i}that{/i} version of yourself, why not play it up instead of retreating back to your comfort zone?
lines.zh: : 我只是说……如果这是你能做{i}那个{/i}版本的自己的最后一晚，为什么不把它玩到底，反而退回你的舒适区呢？

lines.en: : Sensei clearly likes this Miku. Why take her away?
lines.zh: : 老师显然喜欢这个 Miku。为什么要把她弄走？

lines.en: : Cause at this point, I don’t know if {i}any{/i} Miku is going to be able to stay awake.
lines.zh: : 因为到这个地步，我不知道还有{i}哪个{/i} Miku 能保持清醒。

lines.en: scene thevaliumscene9
: Then we’ve just gotta do something fun!
lines.zh: : 那我们就得干点好玩的事！

lines.en: : You snapped out of it for a second when you won the contest, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你赢比赛的时候清醒了一瞬间，对吧？

lines.en: : Did I? I don’t remember.
lines.zh: : 有吗？我不记得了。

lines.en: : You did. Which tells me that, in order to stay awake, you just need a little {i}more{/i} stuff to excite you! And what better way of getting that blood pumping than relying on your new crush?
lines.zh: : 你有。这说明，为了保持清醒，你只是需要{i}更多{/i}能让你兴奋的东西！而还有什么比靠你新的暗恋对象更能让血液沸腾的呢？

lines.en: : You think he’ll carry me? Cause I ain’t sure if I can walk if we’re goin’ anywhere.
lines.zh: : 你觉得他会背我吗？因为如果我们去哪儿的话，我不确定我还走不走得了。

lines.en: : Oh, yes. I’m quite sure he’d be happy to carry you.
lines.zh: : 哦，是的。我很确信他会很乐意背你。

lines.en: : Then sign me the heck up, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 那给我报名吧，Kirin。

lines.en: : I will. Don’t you worry.
lines.zh: : 我会的。别担心。

lines.en: : In fact, don’t worry about anything at all if you’re not feeling up to it. Save that energy for later and leave all of the talking to me. I’ll make sure he comes along.
lines.zh: : 事实上，如果你不舒服，什么都别操心。把力气留到后面，说话的事全交给我。我保证他会跟来。

lines.en: : Think you can handle it? Sensei ain’t that easy to convince.
lines.zh: : 你觉得你能搞定吗？老师可没那么容易说服。

lines.en: : That just tells me you don’t know {i}how{/i} to convince him yet.
lines.zh: : 这只能说明你还不知道{i}怎么{/i}说服他。

lines.en: scene black
: But again, don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 不过再说一次，别担心。

lines.en: : I’ll teach you.
lines.zh: : 我会教你的。

lines.en: else:
scene thevaliumscene10
: Hah...This is what I get for opening myself up for a second.
lines.zh: : 哈……这就是我敞开心扉一秒钟的下场。

lines.en: : Kirin, you’ve been open for business since the day I met you.
lines.zh: : Kirin，我从认识你那天起，你就一直敞着大门营业了。

lines.en: : Not like that, Miku.
lines.zh: : 不是那个意思，Miku。

lines.en: scene black
: Let’s just hurry up and get you back to the hotel before anyone realizes that you’re drugged up.
lines.zh: : 我们赶紧趁没人发现你被药嗨了，把你弄回酒店吧。

lines.en: : Kaaaay...I’m gonna sleep like a rock, so I’m trustin’ you to not do anythin’ weird to me.
lines.zh: : 好————的……我会睡得像块石头，所以我相信你不会对我做什么奇怪的事。

lines.en: : Does taking your makeup off count as weird? Because I wouldn’t be able to live with myself if I let you fall asleep with all of that on.
lines.zh: : 帮你卸妆算奇怪吗？因为要是让你带着那一脸妆睡着，我可没法原谅自己。

lines.en: : Just don’t touch my ears. I’m weak there.
lines.zh: : 别碰我的耳朵。我那儿很敏感。

lines.en: : Well, now I {i}have{/i} to...
lines.zh: : 嗯，那我现在{i}非碰不可{/i}了……

lines.en: I make my way back into the bar after miraculously avoiding what was sure to be my hardest decision of the weekend.
lines.zh: 在奇迹般地躲过了这个周末对我来说最艰难的那个决定之后，我走回了酒吧。

lines.en: This means that, fortunately no one had their heart broken or felt betrayed by me tonight.
lines.zh: 这意味着，幸好今晚没有人被我伤了心，也没有人觉得被我背叛。

lines.en: This also means that, unfortunately, my chances of getting laid on Christmas have greatly decreased.
lines.zh: 这也意味着，不幸的是，我在圣诞节挨操的概率大大降低了。

lines.en: But if there is anything I know about my likelihood of getting laid, it is that it’s never 0%%.
lines.zh: 但如果说我对我挨操的概率有什么了解的话，那就是它永远不会是 0%%。

lines.en: And that’s good enough for me.
lines.zh: 而这对我就已经足够了。

lines.en: if kirin_lust >= 30 and miku_lust >= 10 and mikucostumewin == True:
scene thevaliumscene11
: Hey. What are you doing right now?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你现在在干什么？

lines.en: : I was-
lines.zh: : 我正——

lines.en: : Wrong. You’re hanging out with us.
lines.zh: : 错。你在跟我们玩。

lines.en: : Okay, I guess I’m hanging out with you. But let it be known that the others are going to approach me and take me away after another few lines of dialogue because that’s just how it works.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那我就是在跟你们玩。但先说清楚，再过几句台词，其他人就会来找我把我带走，因为事情一向就是这样运作的。

lines.en: : Then we’ve just gotta beat them to the punch and get out of here before they have a chance to do that.
lines.zh: : 那我们只好先下手为强，在他们有机会那么做之前离开这里。

lines.en: : Out of here?
lines.zh: : 离开这里？

lines.en: scene thevaliumscene12
: Yeah. Miku and I were just talking about how sad we are that we haven’t gotten to spend much time with you this weekend.
lines.zh: : 对。Miku 和我刚还在说，这个周末都没怎么和你待在一起，我们有多伤心。

lines.en: : We were?
lines.zh: : 我们有吗？

lines.en: : {i}Yup.{/i} And we thought that maybe the three of us could head back to the hotel early and have a little fun together.
lines.zh: : {i}有{/i}。而且我们在想，也许我们三个可以早点回酒店，一起玩一玩。

lines.en: scene thevaliumscene13
: What that means, only time will tell!
lines.zh: : 那是什么意思，只有时间能告诉我们！

lines.en: : You do like having {i}fun...{/i}don’t you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢{i}玩的……{/i}对吧，老师？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: ...Sensei?
: Are you on board with this, Miku?
lines.zh: : 你也同意吗，Miku？

lines.en: : Teach, please. I’m on board with like, literally whatevs. If bestie says let’s go have fun, Miku’s gonna go have fun.
lines.zh: : 老师拜托。我 literally 什么都行的。闺蜜说去玩，Miku 就去玩。

lines.en: : You realize the contest is over right? You don’t have to stay in character anymore.
lines.zh: : 你意识到比赛已经结束了吧？你不用再保持人设了。

lines.en: scene thevaliumscene14
: She loves this character! Right, Miku?
lines.zh: : 她爱死这个人设了！对吧，Miku？

lines.en: : Huh? Oh. Oh, yeah. It’s great. I love not understanding what I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 哈？哦。哦，对。很棒。我爱死听不懂自己在说什么的感觉了。

lines.en: scene thevaliumscene11
: See? She’s all about it.
lines.zh: : 瞧？她完全没问题。

lines.en: : Kirin-
lines.zh: : Kirin——

lines.en: : Sensei, come on! Before I change my mind! Who knows how many lines of dialogue we have left?!
lines.zh: : 老师，快点！趁我还没改主意！谁知道我们还剩几句台词？！

lines.en: : Sensei, can you carry me?
lines.zh: : 老师，你能背我吗？

lines.en: : Carry you? Why would-
lines.zh: : 背你？为什么——

lines.en: : Contest reward! A little bonus since Miku floored you with her amazing costume and above-average roleplaying skills.
lines.zh: : 比赛奖励！一点小福利，因为 Miku 用她那身惊艳的服装和高于平均水平的角色扮演把你打趴下了。

lines.en: : I also can’t feel my legs.
lines.zh: : 而且我的腿也没知觉了。

lines.en: : Gyaru really do say some {i}crazy{/i} things now, huh?
lines.zh: : 现在的辣妹说话可真够{i}疯的{/i}，哈？

lines.en: : This seems a little sketchy to me.
lines.zh: : 这在我看来有点可疑。

lines.en: : That’s just because you’re still in work mode! Come relax with us! This top is so tight that it's cutting off my circulation anyway. And I’m sure Miku feels the same way about her fishnets.
lines.zh: : 那只是因为你还处于工作模式！来跟我们放松一下吧！这件上衣紧得都快把我的血液循环切断了。而且我肯定 Miku 对她那渔网袜也是同样的感觉。

lines.en: : Yeah. And they ain’t even caught any fish.
lines.zh: : 是啊。而且它们连一条鱼都没捞到。

lines.en: else:
scene thevaliumscene15
: Hey. How much do you love me?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你有多爱我？

lines.en: : Zero.
: Good. But how much do you love Miku?
lines.zh: : 好。那你有多爱 Miku？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Slightly more than zero?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。比零稍微多一点？

lines.en: : Great, because we need your help with something.
lines.zh: : 太好了，因为我们需要你帮个忙。

lines.en: : I am assuming it’s something that’s going to take me away from the party?
lines.zh: : 我猜是会把我从派对上带走的事？

lines.en: : And you would be correct in assuming that, yes.
lines.zh: : 你这么猜是对的，是的。

lines.en: : Yeah. That’s how most parties seem to end for me nowadays.
lines.zh: : 是啊。现在大多数派对对我来说好像都是这么结束的。

lines.en: : What is it? What do you need help with?
lines.zh: : 是什么？你们需要帮什么忙？

lines.en: : Io gave Miku a Valium and now Miku is about to pass out.
lines.zh: : Io 给了 Miku 一片安定，现在 Miku 快昏过去了。

lines.en: : This sounds like a job for Makoto.
lines.zh: : 这听起来像是该找 Makoto 的活儿。

lines.en: : Sensei, come on. Do you really want to bother Makoto with this after all she’s been through lately? I can handle it.
lines.zh: : 老师，拜托。Makoto 最近经历了那么多，你真想拿这种事去烦她吗？我能处理。

lines.en: : I just need your help carrying her back to the hotel. Or at least the Uber that will take us to the hotel. But you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 我只需要你帮我把她背回酒店。或者至少背到能带我们去酒店的出租车上。但你懂我意思。

lines.en: : Wait, why did Miku take some of Io’s medication in the first place?
lines.zh: : 等等，Miku 一开始为什么要吃 Io 的药？

lines.en: : I can’t remember. But I’m sure glad I did.
lines.zh: : 我不记得了。但我很高兴我吃了。

lines.en: : You ever just think of phones before, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师，你有没有就那么想过手机？

lines.en: : Why did you let this happen?
lines.zh: : 你为什么让这种事发生了？

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter. Are you in or not?
lines.zh: : 不重要。你到底参不参加？

lines.en: : Phones are like...they put all of the knowledge in the world inside a little box that you have to put {i}another{/i} little box on top of to protect it.
lines.zh: : 手机就像……他们把全世界的知识都塞进一个小盒子里，而你还得在它上面{i}再放一个{/i}小盒子来保护它。

lines.en: : Yeah, I should probably help.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我大概该帮忙。

lines.en: scene thevaliumscene16
: Okay then! On that note, let’s go wait outside. It’s way too stuffy in here and I need some fresh air anyway.
lines.zh: : 那就这么定了！那我们出去等吧。这里太闷了，我也需要点新鲜空气。

lines.en: : I should probably at least say bye to-
lines.zh: : 我至少该去告个别——

lines.en: : And risk getting stopped? No way. We have to do this now.
lines.zh: : 然后冒被拦下的风险？想都别想。我们现在就得走。

lines.en: : I really don’t think another two minutes will-
lines.zh: : 我真的不觉得再多两分钟会——

lines.en: : Ugh...pathetic. Aren’t you supposed to be a {i}man?{/i} Why don’t you just act like one?
lines.zh: : 啧……真没出息。你不是该是个{i}男人{/i}吗？为什么就不能表现得像个男人？

lines.en: : By submitting to everything Kirin wants from me?
lines.zh: : 靠对 Kirin 想要的一切言听计从？

lines.en: : Obvs by escorting these...two lovely ladies back to the hotel, loser. I can’t believe I had to spell it out for you. Hilarious.
lines.zh: : 显然是靠护送这两位……可爱的女士回酒店，废物。真不敢相信我还得给你说这么明白。太好笑了。

lines.en: : So? Are we good? Can we go?
lines.zh: : 所以？我们说好了吗？可以走了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...fine. Whatever. Just lead the way.
lines.zh: : 好……行吧。随便。你带路吧。

lines.en: scene thevaliumscene17
: {i}Thank you, Sensei! You’re so- Miku, watch your foot. There’s a drop- okay. You’re on the ground now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}谢谢你，老师！你真——Miku，小心脚下。有个落差——好吧。你现在躺地上了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Ugh...can you believe the construction around here? It’s like...so outdated. {/i}
lines.zh: : {i}啧……你能相信这周围的施工吗？简直……太老旧了。{/i}

lines.en: scene thevaliumscene18
scene thevaliumscene19
scene thevaliumscene20
: You too?
lines.zh: : 你也是？

lines.en: : Yeah...
: I see...
lines.zh: : 我明白了……

lines.en: : Maybe...nothing will happen?...
lines.zh: : 也许……什么都不会发生？……

lines.en: : Yeah...
scene black
: And maybe the sky will fall.
lines.zh: : 也许天还会塌下来呢。
